details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:plan() mixed branches (protected-handoff path and final `if route["mode"] == "mixed"` block) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The mixed branches call `_heal_report_op` directly, so an item with no accepted label gets a `heal_report` op with `label == ""` and no comment or alert, unlike `_harness_ops`.
  WHY: The harness half of a mixed verdict is silently unreported; severity disagreement (NIT from sonnet and qwen, MAJOR from minimax), highest used.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:_harness_ops() (hold_request append) | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `hold_request` is emitted for a project item even when no report is sendable (empty label).
  WHY: The project is held for a harness fix nobody requested; narrow case because validation stops normally carry `ai:harness-broken`.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:_harness_route() lines 558-586 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Only the first 50 path tokens are classified, so with `target_repo=consumer` and a harness-owned path after position 50 the route is `consumer` and no `heal_report` is added.
  WHY: The harness part of the work is dropped; severity disagreement (NIT from sonnet and minimax, MAJOR from luna), highest used.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:_instruction_paths docstring ~506 and line 530 | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The function can return `HARNESS_MAX_PATH_TOKENS + 1` entries but its docstring still says "capped".
  WHY: A future caller trusting the docstring would take 51 tokens; the only current caller slices to the cap.
- .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml and scripts/unblock_judge.sh:739-741 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `unblock_judge.sh` has no `heal_report` or `hold_request` handling (it logs `unknown_op`), yet the comment says a report is being sent, and the alert is only DEBUG.
  WHY: Until P3b lands, a harness verdict leaves the item blocked with no fix-up and no report while the comment claims one is in flight; severity disagreement (NIT from sonnet, MAJOR from minimax), highest used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Emit ... a `heal_report` operation ... with the item's block label." (harness verdict)
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_actions.py, `_heal_report_op()` and `_harness_ops()`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: For an item with only `ai:blocked`, `_heal_report_op()` sets `label` to an empty string and `_harness_ops()` treats it as unsendable, so no valid report is produced. Other reviewers (sonnet, qwen) judged this deliberate and not a gap.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`_harness_route` (truncated slice) and `plan()` final mixed block | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only the first 50 path tokens are classified, so a harness-owned path at position 51 or later under `target_repo=consumer` yields a `consumer` route with no `heal_report`.
  WHY: The consumer fix-up is filed without the harness part being reported; the existing cap test puts harness paths first.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`_harness_ops` hold_request append | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `hold_request` is emitted although `sendable` is false and no report could be sent.
  WHY: The project would hold with no harness fix in flight; the Telegram WARNING is queued, so the case is not silent.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`plan()` mixed branches calling `_heal_report_op` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On a mixed verdict an item with no accepted label gets a `heal_report` op with `label == ""` and no comment or alert.
  WHY: Whether the harness half is silently dropped depends on P3b handling of a label-less op, which is out of scope.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`_instruction_paths` docstring and `if len(found) > HARNESS_MAX_PATH_TOKENS: break` | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The function can return `HARNESS_MAX_PATH_TOKENS + 1` entries but the docstring says "capped".
  WHY: It does not fail; a future caller trusting the docstring would take 51 tokens.
- .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml and scripts/unblock_judge.sh:740 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Until P3b lands, `unblock_judge.sh` logs `unknown_op` and skips `heal_report` and `hold_request`, and the workflow does not forward the kill switch.
  WHY: A harness verdict leaves the item blocked with no fix-up and no report while the comment says a report is in flight; this is an ordering risk between PRs.
- TASK_GAP (considered, not counted as a gap) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  Requirement: "`heal_report` operation (an issue-kind report via the existing `build-issue-payload` with the item's block label)."
  Expected change site: `scripts/unblock_actions.py`, `_heal_report_op`
  Evidence of absence: An item carrying only a label outside `HEAL_REPORT_LABELS` (such as `ai:blocked`) gets an empty label; this is deliberate and covered by a test, and `build-issue-payload` is P3b's work.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:plan() | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The mixed verdict routing appends a `heal_report` operation without verifying that the report is sendable (label validation).
  WHY: The heal report is silently rejected at the intake and no operator is notified, unlike the harness verdict case.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:_harness_ops() | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `hold_request` is emitted for a project item even when no report is sendable (empty label).
  WHY: The project is held indefinitely awaiting a heal fix that no one requested.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Emit ... a `heal_report` operation ... with the item's block label."
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_actions.py, _heal_report_op() and _harness_ops()
  Evidence of absence: With no label in HEAL_REPORT_LABELS (for example only `ai:blocked`), `label` is an empty string and `_harness_ops()` treats it as unsendable, so no valid report is created.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`_instruction_paths()` docstring line 506 vs line 530 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The break was changed to `>` so the function can return 51 entries, but the docstring still says "capped" at 50.
  WHY: `_harness_route` (line 558) slices to the cap, so there is no live bug, but the docstring contract is now false.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`_harness_route()` lines 558-560 and 581-586 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cap is applied asymmetrically, so a harness-owned path beyond the cap is invisible to the classifier.
  WHY: With `target_repo=consumer`, 50 consumer paths and then `validation/x.sh`, the route is `consumer` with no `heal_report` (line 1084), and the harness work is dropped; `tests/test_unblock_judge.py:4353` does not cover this ordering.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`plan()` lines 905-906 and 1084-1086 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The two `mixed` call sites append `_heal_report_op()` directly, bypassing the `sendable` handling in `_harness_ops` (lines 622-628, 649-652), so a label-less item gets `label: ""` and no comment or alert.
  WHY: The harness half of a mixed verdict is silently unreported, which is the failure already fixed for the `harness` route.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`_harness_ops()` lines 623-628 and 649-650; scripts/unblock_judge.sh:739-741 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The executor has no `heal_report` or `hold_request` case, so both log `unknown_op`; the comment says "A workflow-failure heal report is being sent" and the only alert is `DEBUG`.
  WHY: A harness verdict leaves the item blocked with no fix-up, dispatch or page while the comment claims a report is in flight, until P3b lands.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`_harness_route()` lines 575–586 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When instructions contain more than 50 path tokens, truncation does not produce a `mixed` route if the first 50 paths are project-owned and `harness_paths` is empty.
  WHY: With `target_repo="consumer"` the function returns `mode="consumer"`, so `plan()` does not add the required `heal_report` for the harness-owned work.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: "Harness verdict in plan(): no fix-up. Emit … a `heal_report` operation."
  Expected change site: `scripts/unblock_actions.py`, `_heal_report_op()` and `_harness_ops()`
  Evidence of absence: For an item with only `ai:blocked`, `_heal_report_op()` sets `label` to an empty string and `_harness_ops()` reports that no heal report can be sent; the required report is not produced.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`plan()` final mixed block and protected-handoff mixed branch | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: With no label in `HEAL_REPORT_LABELS`, `_heal_report_op` returns an op with `label=""` and nothing in the comment or telegram says the harness half could not be reported.
  WHY: The harness portion of a mixed verdict is silently dropped; the two `mixed` append sites skip the handling in `_harness_ops`.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`_harness_ops()` hold_request append | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `hold_request` is emitted for a project item even when `sendable` is False.
  WHY: The poller could hold for up to `VALIDATION_HARNESS_HOLD_MAX_DAYS` waiting for a fix nothing requested; narrow because stops normally carry `ai:harness-broken`.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`_instruction_paths` docstring and `if len(found) > HARNESS_MAX_PATH_TOKENS: break` | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function can return `HARNESS_MAX_PATH_TOKENS + 1` entries but the docstring still says "capped".
  WHY: A caller trusting the docstring would assume at most 50 tokens; the runtime behavior is correct.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
